candidates.statement: Redis reserve_inventory operations time out (~2s) across all checkout traces, causing inventory 503, order ReadTimeout, and gateway 502s on /v1/checkout.
candidates.uncertainty: No Redis-side metrics/logs admitted; underlying cause of the Redis timeout (saturation, network) is unconfirmed.

report.explanation: Traces show redis.reserve_inventory timing out at ~2s in every correlation, propagating to inventory 503, order ReadTimeout, and gateway 502 on /v1/checkout. Metrics confirm 16 502s/60s and p95 ~2425ms on /v1/checkout. Topology places redis behind inventory. Bounded candidate: redis-timeout.
missing_evidence: Redis server-side latency, saturation, and error metrics
Logs for inventory/redis (ev-...-r0-logs excluded) to confirm timeout origin
